title: Yummy Moroccan Lamb Tagine
description: A funky, cheese-pull midnight craving Moroccan dish with rose water and kombu cold extract, dairy-free and served in a terracotta dish.

ingredients.name: Moroccan spice blend (cumin, coriander, paprika, cinnamon)

instructions: Heat olive oil in a terracotta dish over medium heat until shimmering.
Add diced onion and cook until translucent, about 3 to 4 minutes.
Stir in minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add ground lamb, breaking it apart, and cook until browned, about 5 to 7 minutes.
Sprinkle the Moroccan spice blend and tomato paste, stirring to coat the meat evenly.
Pour in vegetable broth and kombu cold extract, bring to a low simmer, cover, and let cook for 30 minutes.
Stir in rose water, dried apricots, and season with salt and pepper; simmer uncovered for 15 more minutes until sauce thickens.
Add chopped cilantro, fold in half of the vegan cheese, then place the remaining cheese on top.
Cover again and cook until cheese melts and forms a pully layer, about 5 to 7 minutes.
Remove from heat, let rest 5 minutes, then serve hot, optionally garnished with extra cilantro.
